about: Towns track TW-3: a run's quests (logic/run-quests.js). Each run town's quest giver offers one, drawn from the town's own stream; at most the rules' held count are held; a done quest is handed in at a later town's notice board for a reward pick. Texts drafted by Claude, approved by the owner (2026-10-25). {type} is a Billie type, {n} the goal.

parcel.title: Carry a parcel to the next town

miniboss.title: Beat the next mini-boss, nobody fainting

texts.ask: My grandson wants a {type} Billie for his birthday. I can’t catch one. My knees can’t either.
I’m writing a book on {type} Billies. Chapter one is still blank. Catch me one to look at?
A {type} Billie used to visit my garden. Catch one, just so I know they’re still about.
Bet you can’t catch a {type} Billie before the next town. Go on, prove me wrong.
The road’s full of show-offs with Billies. Beat {n} of them and they’ll keep it down.
I run the town’s battle club. Beat {n} trainers on the road and you’re in, no fee.
My nephew says he’s the best trainer on the road. Beat {n} and he’ll have to share the title.
Trainers keep stopping my deliveries for a battle. Beat {n} of them and maybe they’ll learn.
This parcel’s for the next town you reach. It’s mostly jam. Mind the jam.
Take this letter to the next town? It’s an apology. It’s quite long.
Seeds for the next town’s gardener. Don’t plant them on the way, they’ll know.
My sister lives in the next town. Take her this scarf. I knitted it twice.
Someone big waits up the road. Beat them without a single Billie fainting and I’ll owe you.
Anyone can win ugly. Beat the next mini-boss and keep your whole team standing. That’s style.
I bet the baker you’d beat the next mini-boss with nobody fainting. Don’t make me pay for bread.
My old team lost to that mini-boss. Beat them clean, nobody fainting. For my pride.

say.yes: Thank you! Come back to any town’s notice board once it’s done.
say.full: You’ve got your hands full. Come back with fewer quests.
say.none: Nothing needs doing today. Safe travels!
say.done: Notice board: {title}. Done! Pick a reward.
